thread:
maria: Heads-up — noticed the TOC on docs/runbook/deploy-scale.md is collapsed and several anchors 3.2-3.5 are 404ing. Quick sweep?
noah: can you paste the broken link(s)?
maria: https://redwood.internal/docs/runbook/deploy-scale#3.2 (and #3.4) — showing as dead in the sidebar.
leo: ack, I saw this crop up in Lighthouse yesterday. suspect the TOC refactor from last week.
anya: @maria can you add this to the docs rota for the week? I can pick it up Wed-Fri. :raising_hand: 
maria: will do. planning a tiny PR: update anchor ids and rehost one image. opening in a few.
noah: 👍 let me know when it's up, I can review after lunch.
maria: quick preview of the fix: replacing `### 3.2 Foo Bar` with `### 3.2 Foo Bar {: #foo-bar }` to keep anchors stable. also adding frontmatter owners.
noah: nice. can you include a one-line smoke test for CI?
maria: adding this script to the PR body:
```bash
# verify headings generate expected anchors
rg "foo-bar" docs/runbook/deploy-scale.md || exit 1
```
leo: also spotted a broken image reference: /images/kv-cache-arch.png — CDN 403 when linked from that page.
anya: is that coming from staging or prod? saw similar in another doc.
maria: image moved in S3 when we reorganized assets. plan: rehost under assets.redwood and update path in the doc.
eng-infra: noted — we can provision a signed URL and set a short redirect for the old path. will need PR with the new asset path.
noah: can we add `owners: ["eng-infra","docs"]` to the frontmatter so rota picks this up?
maria: yup, adding frontmatter owners and a small note in the PR.
noah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/12347 — includes anchor fixes, frontmatter owners, and image rehost plan. CI running.
dev-bot: CI update — link-checker started on PR #12347.
leo: reviewing now, will flag tiny nits if any.
dev-bot: CI: link-checker found 2 anchors initially; latest commit resolves both.
anya: sweet. who will merge after approvals? I'm offline after 17:00.
noah: I can merge once CI is green and at least one reviewer approves.
maria: tagging @eng-docs for visibility in the PR description. thanks all! :rocket: 
leo: quick follow-up suggestion — add a short guideline to the contributor guide about preserving stable anchors when reorganizing headings (one paragraph).
maria: will draft that as a separate mini-PR after this merges.
noah: perfect. saves future churn.
maria: thanks everyone — ping me if anything else pops up.
